questions.question: Which of the following fields is NOT covered by the National Eminence Award?

options.text: Music of all forms and origin

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Literature**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Eminence Award (also known as Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship) recognizes individuals for their contributions in **Theatre, Dance, and Music**.
 
• It is the highest honor conferred by the Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's National Academy for Music, Dance, and Drama.
 
• The award does not specifically cover the field of **Literature**, as it primarily focuses on the performing arts.
 
• Recipients of the award are selected for their exceptional dedication and lifelong achievements in their respective fields of performing arts.
 
• Fields such as **Music of all forms and origin**, Theatre, and Dance are prominently included in the scope of the award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi:**

 
 
• It is India's National Academy for Music, Dance, and Drama, established in 1953 by the Indian government.
 
• The Akademi aims to preserve and promote India's cultural heritage in performing arts.
 
• Apart from awards, it conducts research, documentation, and the publication of materials related to performing arts.
 
 
 
• **Fields of Recognition:**
 
 
• The awards focus on Theatre, Music (Hindustani, Carnatic, and folk traditions), and Dance (classical and traditional forms).
 
• It also includes allied performing arts, puppetry, and the contribution of scholars and teachers in these fields.
 
 
 
• **Structure of the Award:**
 
 
• The award includes a citation, a memento, and a cash prize.
 
• It is one of the most prestigious recognitions for performing artists in India.
 
 
 
• **Notable Recipients:**
 
 
• Some legendary recipients include M.S. Subbulakshmi (Music), Rukmini Devi Arundale (Dance), and Habib Tanvir (Theatre).
 
• These individuals have contributed significantly to the preservation and global recognition of Indian performing arts.

questions.question: Who received the National Nritya Shiromani award 2019 for promoting Kathak dance form across the world?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Anindita Neogy Anaam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Anindita Neogy Anaam is a renowned Kathak dancer known for her remarkable contributions to the dance form.
 
• She received the National Nritya Shiromani award in 2019 for promoting Kathak across the globe.
 
• The award was presented at the 10th Cuttack Mahotsav: International Dance and Music Festival held in Odisha.
 
• Anindita is celebrated for her innovative approach in blending traditional Kathak with contemporary elements, making it more appealing to the younger generation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak Dance Form:**

 
 
• Kathak is one of the eight classical dance forms of India, originating from Northern India.
 
• It is characterized by intricate footwork, spins, and expressive gestures.
 
• The dance form traditionally narrates stories from Indian epics, folklore, and mythology.
 
• Kathak has three main gharanas (schools) - Lucknow, Jaipur, and Banaras, each with its unique style and emphasis.
 
 
 
• **National Nritya Shiromani Award:**
 
 
• This award is given to exceptional dancers who have significantly contributed to the promotion and preservation of Indian classical dance forms.
 
• It recognizes artists who have achieved excellence in their field and have promoted the art form both nationally and internationally.
 
 
 
• **Cuttack Mahotsav:**
 
 
• An international festival that celebrates dance and music, held annually in Cuttack, Odisha.
 
• The festival aims to promote cultural exchange and provides a platform for artists from various parts of the world to showcase their talents.
 
 
 
• **Role of Dance Festivals:**
 
 
• Dance festivals play a crucial role in preserving and promoting cultural heritage.
 
• They provide a platform for emerging artists to perform and gain recognition.
 
• Such festivals encourage the younger generation to appreciate and learn classical dance forms.

questions.question: Dr. Bhupendra Kumar Hazarika won the Bharat Ratna award in the field of __________ in 2019.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Music**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Bhupendra Kumar Hazarika** was a renowned Indian playback singer, lyricist, musician, singer, poet, and film-maker.
 
• He was awarded the **Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian award, posthumously in **2019**. - His contributions were primarily in the field of music, where he composed numerous songs in Assamese, Hindi, and Bengali.
 
• Bhupen Hazarika was also known for his role in popularizing **Assamese folk music and culture**.
 
• He was a recipient of several other prestigious awards, including the **Padma Bhushan and the Padma Vibhushan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Award
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Bharat Ratna
 India's highest civilian award, given for exceptional service towards the advancement of art, literature, and science, and in recognition of public service of the highest order.
 
 

 Padma Bhushan
 India's third-highest civilian award, given for distinguished service of a high order in any field.
 
 

 Padma Vibhushan
 India's second-highest civilian award, given for exceptional and distinguished service in any field, including service rendered by Government servants.
 
 

 National Film Award
 India's most prominent film award ceremony, recognizing excellence in the Indian film industry.
 
 

 Sangeet Natak Akademi Award
 India's national academy for music, dance, and drama, recognizing outstanding achievement in these fields.

questions.question: Who among the following was the first-ever Indian to receive the Bharat Ratna award?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandrasekhara Venkata Raman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharat Ratna**__

 __
 
• Instituted in the year 1954, **Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian award in India. **It is **awarded in recognition of exceptional service towards any field of human endeavour**, without distinction of race, occupation, position or sex. 
 
• A **maximum of three Bharat Ratna awards can be given each year** upon the **recommendations made by the Prime Minister to the President of India**. On conferment of the award, the **recipient receives a Sanad (certificate) signed by the President and a medallion.** No monetary grant is associated with the award. 
 
• As mentioned in** Article 18(1) of the Indian Constitution,** the** recipients cannot use Bharat Ratna as a prefix or suffix to their names. **However, a recipient** can use the below-mentioned expression** in their biodata, letterhead, visiting card, etc. 
 
• **The first scientist to receive Bharat Ratna was C. V. Raman (1954). Hence, Option 3 is correct.**
 
• C. V. Raman was an Indian Physicist.
 
• He discovered the Scattering of Light.
 
• On **28th February 1930, **he got the **Nobel Prize for Physics** for the discovery of the Raman Effect 
 
• **National Science Day** is celebrated in India on **28th February** each year to mark the discovery of the Raman Effect.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharat Ratna **is the highest civilian award of the Republic of India.
 
• Bharat Ratna was introduced on **2ⁿd January 1954.**
 
• The first three recipients of Bharat Ratna are **C. Rajagopalachari, S. Radhakrishnan, and C. V. Raman.**
 
• The first person to receive Bharat Ratna was **C. Rajagopalachari.**
 
• The first scientist to receive Bharat Ratna was **C. V. Raman (1954).**
 
• The first Prime Minister to receive Bharat Ratna was **Jawaharlal Nehru (1955).**
 
• The first President to receive Bharat Ratna was **Dr. Rajendra Prasad (1962)**.
 
• The first person to receive Bharat Ratna posthumously was **Lal Bahadhur Shastri (1966).**
 
• The first woman to receive Bharat Ratna was **Indira Gandhi (1971).**
 
• The first foreigner to receive Bharat Ratna was **Khan Abdul Gaffar Khan (1987).**
 
• The second foreigner to receive Bharat Ratna was **Nelson Mandela (1990).**
 
• The first woman to receive Bharat Ratna posthumously was **Aruna Asif Ali (1997).**
 
• The first sportsperson and youngest person to receive Bharat Ratna was **Sachin Tendulkar (2014).**
 
• In 2019, three persons to receive Bharat Ratna **Pranab Mukherjee, Bhupen Hazarika (posthumously), and Nanaji Deshmukh.**

questions.question: Renowned Indian classical dancer Mrinalini Sarabhai was awarded with the _____ in 1965.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Shri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• Mrinalini Sarabhai is famous for Bharatanatyam.
 
• Mrinalini's older sister Lakshmi Sehgal was the commander-in-chief of the Rani of the Jhansi regiment which was an all-women combat regiment of the Indian National Army.

**Padma Awards**

 
• Padma Awards one of the highest civilian Awards in the country are conferred in three categories, namely, Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri.
 
• The Awards are given in various disciplines/ fields of activities,
 
 
• Art, social work, public affairs, science and engineering, trade and industry, medicine, literature and education, sports, civil service, etc.
 
 
 
• Padma Vibhushan is awarded for exceptional and distinguished service.
 
• Padma Bhushan for distinguished service of a high order.
 
• Padma Shri for distinguished service in any field.
 
• The awards are announced on the occasion of Republic Day every year. 
 
• These awards are conferred by the President of India.

questions.question: Who among the following dancers won the prestigious Padma Shree award in the year 2021, for her contribution to folk dance?

__

• Her journey as a transgender dancer has inspired many and brought attention to the rich heritage of folk arts in India.

 __
